methodology_other: REACH / UNOSAT datasets and maps are produced using a variety of methods. In general, analysts closely review satellite imagery, often comparing two or more images together, and determine notable changes between the images. In this instance, analysts review best available imagery and manually digitize the centerlines of roads and footpaths in refugee settlements.
name: cox-s-bazar-refugee-settlement-roads-and-footpaths
notes: Satellite and UAV imagery derived roads and footpaths of Rohingya refugee settlements in Cox's Bazar District, Bangladesh. Based on best available imagery acquired in October 2017.
